user.title: Connect a Yale lock
user.description: Select an existing August account and its lock. No new credentials are stored. The account must be a lock owner.

error.unknown_device: The lock does not belong to the selected August account.
error.source_unavailable: Configure and load the August integration first.
error.access_denied: The August account must have owner access to this lock.
error.unsupported_lock: This lock does not support entry codes.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Yale. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Yale is limiting requests. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Yale returned an unexpected response. Try again later.

abort.no_august: Configure the official August integration before adding Yale Access Manager.

list_accesses.title: Accesses

update_access.title: Choose access to replace
update_access.description: Only this integration's accesses can be changed. Replacement deletes the previous PIN before loading the new one; a short interruption is expected.

delete_access.title: Delete managed access
delete_access.description: Submitting deletes the selected entry from the lock. App-created entries are protected.

details.title: Access details
details.description: Enter a new PIN of 4 to 8 digits. PINs are never saved in integration options or entity state.

schedule.title: Access schedule
schedule.description: Temporary dates use Home Assistant's timezone. Weekly times use the lock's timezone configured in the Yale app; overnight windows are not supported.

reconcile_access.title: Verify a loaded access
reconcile_access.description: Enter the PIN, name and schedule that should be loaded. This only reads Yale; it never repeats a write.

disable_access.title: Disable access
disable_access.description: Select a managed access. Disabling retains its identity and association.

enable_access.title: Enable access
enable_access.description: Select a managed access. Disabling retains its identity and association.

bind_person.title: Link person
bind_person.description: Select a managed access. Disabling retains its identity and association.

cancel_pending_access.title: Cancel pending access
cancel_pending_access.description: Select only the unresolved managed attempt to cancel.

cancel_pending_pin.title: Confirm cancellation
cancel_pending_pin.description: Enter the original attempt's PIN. This sends a deletion to Yale even if the access is absent. The journal is retained if Yale rejects the request or absence is unconfirmed.

person.title: Link person
person.description: Link by identifiers without changing presence. The phone must belong to the person's associated account.

error.invalid_pin: The PIN must contain 4 to 8 ASCII digits.
error.invalid_name: Enter a guest name of 1 to 80 characters.
error.invalid_schedule: Check the access dates, weekdays and times. The end must be later than the start; temporary access must not already be expired.
error.unsupported_schedule: This lock does not support access schedules.
error.duplicate_pin: That PIN is already assigned to another entry on this lock.
error.operation_pending: The previous operation is unresolved. View accesses and refresh later; do not repeat creation blindly.
error.outcome_unknown: Yale has not confirmed completion. View accesses before making further changes.
error.write_rejected: Yale rejected the change. Check the input and lock capacity.
error.update_rolled_back: Yale rejected the replacement; the previous PIN was restored.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Yale. Try again later.
error.source_unavailable: The source August integration is unavailable.
error.access_denied: The August account must have owner access to this lock.
error.rate_limited: Yale is limiting requests. Try again later.
error.not_managed: This integration does not own that access.
error.invalid_response: Yale returned an unexpected response. No completion is assumed.
error.invalid_person: Select a person and a Companion phone registered to the same account.
error.ambiguous_person: Link exactly one managed guest to this person for this lock.
error.identity_changed: The Yale identity changed. Review the guest before authorizing another access.
error.issue_failed: Code delivery is unconfirmed. Access revocation was requested; inspect its state.

abort.not_ready: The integration must be loaded before managing access.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to read accesses from Yale.
abort.no_managed_accesses: Create an access with this integration first.
abort.no_mobile_app: Configure a Home Assistant Companion phone.

list_accesses.name: List accesses
list_accesses.description: Return guest metadata and management IDs without PIN values.

create_access.name: Create access
create_access.description: Create an entry and wait for Yale to confirm it is loaded. PIN inputs can appear in automation traces.

name.name: Guest name
name.description: The name shown in the Yale app.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: 4 to 8 digits; not included in responses or entity state.

starts_at.name: Starts at
starts_at.description: Required for temporary access; local HA time or an ISO timestamp with offset.

start_time.name: Daily start
start_time.description: Required for recurring access, in the lock's timezone.

end_time.name: Daily end
end_time.description: Required for recurring access; same-day windows only.

update_access.name: Replace access
update_access.description: Replace a managed entry's name, PIN and schedule using delete then load. There is a short access interruption. PIN inputs can appear in automation traces.

access_id.name: Access ID
access_id.description: A managed ID returned by List accesses.

start_time.name: Daily start
start_time.description: Required for recurring access, in the lock's timezone.

end_time.name: Daily end
end_time.description: Required for recurring access; same-day windows only.

delete_access.name: Delete access
delete_access.description: Remove a managed entry and wait until Yale no longer reports it.

access_id.name: Access ID
access_id.description: A managed ID returned by List accesses.

reconcile_access.name: Verify pending access
reconcile_access.description: Verify a loaded entry against its expected PIN and metadata without writing to Yale. PIN inputs can appear in automation traces.

access_id.name: Access ID
access_id.description: A managed ID returned by List accesses.

start_time.name: Daily start
start_time.description: Required for recurring access, in the lock's timezone.

end_time.name: Daily end
end_time.description: Required for recurring access; same-day windows only.

disable_access.name: Disable access
disable_access.description: Administrator only; retain the managed identity.

enable_access.name: Enable access
enable_access.description: Administrator only; retain the managed identity.

bind_person.name: Link person
bind_person.description: Administrator only; retain the managed identity.

person_entity_id.name: Person
person_entity_id.description: Person linked by its stable identifier.

notification_entry_id.name: Companion phone
notification_entry_id.description: mobile_app registration belonging to the person's account.

issue_access.name: Issue temporary code
issue_access.description: Renew the PIN for ten minutes and send it to the linked phone. Revoke on identified use or expiry. Never return the PIN.

person_entity_id.name: Person
person_entity_id.description: Person linked by its stable identifier.

cancel_pending_access.name: Cancel pending access
cancel_pending_access.description: Send deletion for the original partner using its PIN. Pending attempts only; retain the journal on uncertainty. PIN inputs can appear in automation traces.

access_id.name: Pending access ID
access_id.description: The managed pending ID returned by List accesses.

pin.name: Original PIN
pin.description: The PIN used by the unresolved attempt.

begin_visit.name: Begin guest visit
begin_visit.description: Reserve one question for a linked guest's visit and return their verified Companion notification service. A new question is blocked for 30 minutes.

person_entity_id.name: Person
person_entity_id.description: The person linked to one managed guest.

end_visit.name: End guest visit
end_visit.description: Clear the visit after confirmed departure. The 30-minute question cooldown remains in effect.
